title: Salesforce Developer
description:
Salesforce Developer Apex | Lightning | SOQL | Salesforce Company: Spark Techwave InnovationZ Pvt Ltd
 Job Type: Full-Time
 Experience: 26 Years
 Location: Chennai / Remote / Hybrid
 Department: IT / Software Engineering Job Summary Spark Techwave InnovationZ Pvt Ltd is looking for a skilled Salesforce Developer with hands-on experience in Salesforce development, customization, configuration, and integrations. The ideal candidate should have strong knowledge of Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), SOQL, Salesforce objects, automation, and APIs . The candidate will work with business and technical teams to develop scalable Salesforce solutions based on business requirements. Key Responsibilities Develop, customize, and maintain Salesforce applications. Develop Apex classes, triggers, controllers, and asynchronous Apex solutions. Build user interfaces using Lightning Web Components (LWC) . Write and optimize SOQL/SOSL queries. Configure Salesforce objects, fields, relationships, validation rules, and permissions. Develop automation using Flow Builder and other Salesforce automation tools. Implement Salesforce integrations with external applications using REST/SOAP APIs. Work with Salesforce data migration, data loading, and data transformation activities. Troubleshoot and resolve Salesforce application and integration issues. Perform unit testing and debugging of Salesforce components. Participate in requirement analysis, development, testing, deployment, and production support. Follow Salesforce development and security best practices. Maintain technical documentation for customizations, integrations, and solutions. Collaborate with Salesforce Administrators, Business Analysts, QA teams, and other developers. Required Skills 2–6 years of hands-on experience in Salesforce Development . Strong knowledge of Apex . Experience with Lightning Web Components (LWC) . Strong knowledge of SOQL/SOSL . Experience with:
 Apex Classes Apex Triggers Apex Controllers Batch Apex Queueable Apex Future Methods Test Classes Knowledge of Salesforce:
 Objects Fields Relationships Validation Rules Profiles & Permission Sets Sharing Rules Record Types Page Layouts Experience with Salesforce Flow / Flow Builder . Understanding of Salesforce security and governor limits. Experience with REST/SOAP APIs and Salesforce integrations. Knowledge of Salesforce deployment tools and change management. Good debugging and problem-solving skills 
 Send your resume at Careers@sparktechwiz.com

title: Salesforce Developer Lead DATA Remediation
description:
Roles and Responsibilities Data Analysis & Remediation Perform Salesforce Data Pollution Analysis. Identify and document data quality issues. Execute data correction, enrichment, and update activities. Support ongoing data cleansing and remediation efforts. Salesforce Development & Configuration Develop Salesforce solutions to support remediation activities. Perform Salesforce coding and automation tasks. Implement configuration changes that improve data quality and prevent future issues. Support the resolution of integration-related data inconsistencies. Data Remediation Implementation Support Support the implementation of a data remediation tool for quality use cases. Configure and maintain data quality checks and validation processes. Assist with testing and validation of remediation workflows. Data Correction & Purge Activities Analyse blocked records and classify exception types. Segment quick wins versus complex exception cases. Cross-reference Salesforce data with internal and external datasets (e.g., VISSBOSS, ADB). Enrich and update missing or incorrect data. Correct inactive dates and status mismatches. Resolve orphan records and dependency issues. Validate records against Salesforce integrity and purge rules. Support the execution of controlled purge activities. Report progress, remaining issues, and identified risks.

Key Skills: Data Quality Management,Data Cleansing,Data Remediation,Data Governance,Salesforce,Data Validation,Soql,Data Migration/Reconciliation Projects
